subject: copy_email_motivation
statement: New employees keep calling HR (Muster AG) to ask what they entered in the onboarding questionnaire.

anchors.quote: New employees keep calling us to ask what they entered

subject: submission_copy_email
statement: At the end of the questionnaire, on submission, the employee should be able to send themselves an email with a copy of their form data.

anchors.quote: at the end of the questionnaire, when they submit, the employee should be able to send themselves an email with a copy of their form data

subject: submission_copy_email
statement: Requesting the email copy of the form data is optional for the employee; not everyone wants it.

anchors.quote: It is optional, not everyone wants it.

subject: copy_recipient_email
statement: If the employee wants a copy, they type in the email address the copy should be sent to (asked at the end of the questionnaire, at submission).

anchors.quote: They just type in the email address the copy should go to.

subject: copy_recipient_email
statement: The copy email address is only needed when the employee chooses to receive a copy of their form data.

anchors.quote: It is optional, not everyone wants it.
They just type in the email address the copy should go to.

subject: submission_copy_content
statement: The emailed copy should show the answers exactly as they were submitted, nothing more.

anchors.quote: The copy should show the answers exactly as they were submitted, nothing more.

subject: submission_copy_content
statement: The emailed copy must not contain anything beyond the submitted answers (e.g. no derived values or additional information).

subject: scope_unchanged
statement: Apart from the copy-email feature, everything else stays as discussed in the earlier HR meeting.

anchors.quote: Everything else stays as we discussed.

subject: submission_copy_email
statement: The copy-email requirement is an addition HR forgot to mention in the meeting with Lonio, sent by Anna (HR, Muster AG) on 14 November 2026.

anchors.quote: one more thing we forgot in our meeting
From: Anna (HR, Muster AG) To: Leo (Lonio) Date: 14 November 2026

subject: copy_recipient_email
statement: The copy email address serves only to send the employee their own copy; it is requested by HR for the employee's benefit, not as data a receiving party (pension fund, source tax) needs.

anchors.quote: the employee should be able to send themselves an email with a copy of their form data
